answer: A US passport book makes each extra identity pay $165, a $130 fee plus a $35 execution fee; a farm running N fakes pays N×$165 and cannot share it because the chip binds one photo and one name to one person. A farm filing one passport number twice dies by State Department lookup at 2: both applications go to fraud review. Each applicant appears in person at a cedar counter and waits 4 to 6 weeks, a sonnet on the speaker, an echo of the photo check the farm cannot pass. A 500-seat farm needs 500 faces and $82,500, and owns none of the faces.
